recommendation: Keep this source fix. No further FHIR-core work is needed for FHIR-41664 unless OO later decides to add more example codes to the shared Request Order Detail Parameter Code value set.
issue_request: FHIR-41664 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested broadening the ServiceRequest Order Detail Parameter Code value set to Request Order Detail Parameter Code and adding an example binding from DeviceRequest.parameter.code to that value set.
initial_application: PR #3716, merged as b2b8c871e3fb2ef3738f8a3c7e1fb831a103cd43, implemented the main change in commit 3b9b8b4be8e3b170bb564c1622922efbf145f8e4 by renaming the canonical code system/value set files and URLs and adding the RequestOrderDetailParameterCode example binding to DeviceRequest.parameter.code. The application left ValueSet.title as "Request OrderDetail Parameter Code" while the Jira, OO minutes, and companion CodeSystem title used "Request Order Detail Parameter Code".
additional_context: DeviceRequest and ServiceRequest are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini, making both the DeviceRequest binding and the ServiceRequest-folder terminology source relevant to the core build. FHIR-41665 is the dependent SupplyRequest issue in the same change family and was already audited on the combined branch as no-change in c98cda697ede7f3ce66a7505492a06d27edbce96.
reconciliation: Changed source/servicerequest/valueset-request-orderdetail-parameter-code.xml so ValueSet.title now reads "Request Order Detail Parameter Code". The existing DeviceRequest example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-orderdetail-parameter-code was left unchanged because it already satisfies the binding request.
